model_settings.value: General linear model and multiple regression applied voxel-wise; age, sex, total intracranial volume, and years of education were included as covariates. Analyses used SPM2 on Matlab 6.5, with family-wise error correction at P < 0.05.

spans.text: Age and sex are recognized to be strong factors affecting brain morphology. In this study, although subjects were in a very narrow age range, age effects were controlled by including age in the model as a covariate. Total intracranial volume (TIV) and years of education were also included in the model to avoiding their confounding effects.
